text: session-continuation 是 DSH Web 客户端的会话工具，在会话标题操作区提供复制完整 session ID 和复制接续提示词的按钮。提示词包含当前 ID 与历史查阅指引，供用户自行粘贴到新对话；插件本身不读取会话历史。它会校验 ID，并根据 DSH 内置剪贴板的返回状态显示复制结果。适合需要手动将会话定位信息带入新对话的用户，无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

session-continuation adds DSH web session header buttons to copy the full ID or a continuation prompt with the ID and history lookup guidance. Users paste it into a new conversation; the plugin does not read history. It validates IDs and reports clipboard results. No API key is required.
想把当前 DSH 会话的 ID 复制出来，方便在新对话里接着查历史。
能不能在会话标题旁加个按钮，帮我复制一段带会话编号的接续提示？
I want to copy a DSH session ID and a prompt I can paste into a new conversation.
session-continuation 的功能「复制会话 ID」：在会话标题操作区提供按钮，复制当前有效的完整 session ID；ID 不符合格式时按钮不可用。
session-continuation 的功能「复制接续提示词」：点击会话标题旁的按钮，将包含当前 ID 和历史查阅指引的提示词写入内置剪贴板，并显示成功或失败反馈。
session-continuation 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 6；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

ID、异步切换与剪贴板语义 ID需为字母/数字起始，后续允许字母、数字、`.`、`_`、`:`、`-`；支持UUID、session/webhook等安全token。空、非字符串、空白/控制字符及null/undefined字面值禁用复制，不修剪或强转。 使用内置 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives.writeClipboard`；只有true显示成功2秒，false/异常/接口缺失显示失败4秒，无DOM fallback。写入中两按钮禁用；会话切换以React key重建，清理timer并丢弃旧异步反馈。已提交系统的剪贴板写入无法撤销，新点击使用当前ID。窄容器先隐藏短ID，再纵向布局，保留Tab/Enter/Space和可见焦点。

session-continuation README · Introduction：---

A local desktop plugin that displays/copies information only. It does not create conversations, send prompts, read/export history or modify official DSH source. **An ID is a locator, not proof that a new conversation has loaded all context.**

session-continuation README · Features：
🔖 Full session ID

Use only official slot props.sessionId. Hover/focus reveals the full value; wide layouts show a short ID.		 📋 Six-line continuation

Insert the ID into the first line only. The user pastes it into a new conversation, treating history as background.		 ⌨️ Honest clipboard feedback

Native keyboard-accessible buttons report success only when the built-in clipboard returns true.

session-continuation README · How it works：The Client uses only declared `ctx.slots`. The Host is a client-package entry, with no HTTP routes, injected services or history access. Official hideChrome does not cause a duplicate entry to be added.

session-continuation README · Quick start：Requires DSH desktop with `conversation.session.header.actions` (list/session) and built-in clipboard support. Slot/property contracts were checked against 0.2.1-alpha.4; other versions require verification. No third-party runtime dependencies.

```sh
export DSH_HOME="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
git clone https://github.com/yueyexiayu/dsh-session-continuation.git "$DSH_HOME/plugins/session-continuation"
```

session-continuation README · Quick start：Preserve existing entries and merge once into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-continuation
      name: ../../plugins/session-continuation/lib/index.js
```

The path resolves from that patch file and must name the file entry. Fully quit/reopen DSH after installation/load-declaration changes; do not use CLI plugin management to alter desktop profiles. Uninstall only this entry/directory, not other configuration.

请梳理原始目标、已确认决定、已完成事项、当前进度和待办，明确哪些结论已验证、哪些尚未验证。

session-continuation README · Validation and boundaries：
IDs, asynchronous switches and clipboard semantics IDs start with a letter/digit, followed by letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:` or `-`. UUIDs and safe session/webhook tokens are supported. Empty/non-string values, whitespace/control characters and literal null/undefined disable copying; values are not trimmed or coerced.

session-continuation README · Validation and boundaries：Uses `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives.writeClipboard`. Only true shows 2-second success; false/errors/missing APIs show 4-second failure, without a DOM fallback. Both buttons disable during writes. Session changes remount by React key, clear timers and ignore stale feedback. Submitted OS clipboard writes cannot be undone; new clicks use the current ID. Narrow containers hide the short ID then stack controls, preserving Tab/Enter/Space and visible focus.
